_comment: Hypixel The Pit, recorded 27.6s. Steady melee: ~800 packets/s of player movement, damage, particles and scoreboard updates with almost no chunk streaming, so frame time is dominated by entities and HUD rather than by terrain building. settleSeconds skips the recording's opening chunk snapshot; the measured window is replay t=5s..22.5s.
_warmup_note: Raised from 2000/500 after the opening of the measured window was found to be systematically slower: the first 30% of frames ran 3-7ms against a 2ms steady state, and dropping them cut the within-variant spread on a throttled variant from 22% to 9%.
